name: jak1-orbless-min
description: Minimal Orbless behavior ported onto the current Jak 1 GOAL tree. Keeps open-orb pickups hidden and marks collected open orbs complete instead of dead. (AI-assisted)

operations.marker: (quaternion-rotate-y! (-> self root quat) (-> self root quat) (* 40049.777 (seconds-per-frame)))
operations.text:
(if (task-closed? (game-task finalboss-movies) (task-status need-introduction))
          (logclear! (-> self draw status) (draw-status hidden))
          (logior! (-> self draw status) (draw-status hidden)))
        (when (and (= (-> (ppointer->process (-> self parent)) type symbol) 'process-tree)
                   (logtest? (-> self entity extra perm status) (entity-perm-status complete)))
          (logclear! (-> self flags) (collectable-flags can-collect)))

operations.old:
(with-pc
          (if (-> *pc-settings* money-starburst?) (spawn (-> self part) (-> self root root-prim world-sphere))))
operations.new: ;; Orbless: no money starburst while money is hidden

operations.old:
(defstate notice-blue (money)
  :virtual #t
  :code
    (behavior ((arg0 handle))
      (loop
        (quaternion-rotate-y! (-> self root quat) (-> self root quat) (* 91022.22 (seconds-per-frame)))
        (set! (-> self root trans quad) (-> self base quad))
        (add-blue-motion #t #t #t #f)
operations.new:
(defstate notice-blue (money)
  :virtual #t
  :code
    (behavior ((arg0 handle))
      (loop
        (quaternion-rotate-y! (-> self root quat) (-> self root quat) (* 91022.22 (seconds-per-frame)))
        (set! (-> self root trans quad) (-> self base quad))
        (add-blue-motion #t #f #t #f)

(cond
        ((= (-> (ppointer->process (-> self parent)) type symbol) 'process-tree)
          (process-entity-status! self (entity-perm-status complete) #t)
          (when (task-closed? (game-task finalboss-movies) (task-status need-introduction))
            (convert-to-hud-object self (the-as hud (ppointer->process (-> *hud-parts* money)))))
          (go-virtual wait))
        (else
          (process-entity-status! self (entity-perm-status dead) #t)
          (when (task-closed? (game-task finalboss-movies) (task-status need-introduction))
            (convert-to-hud-object self (the-as hud (ppointer->process (-> *hud-parts* money)))))))))
